resources.string: Choose a receiving folder, start transfer and open the address in a computer browser. Connect using the six-digit code. Keep this window in the foreground on the same LAN.
Session expired. Start again to receive more files.
No LAN address available. Connect to Wi-Fi and retry.
Folder access failed. Choose a local writable folder.
Unable to start. Check folder access, LAN permission and Wi-Fi connection.
Failed · %1$s — check browser details, storage and folder access

One upload at a time; up to 500 files, 1 GiB per file and 8 GiB per 20-minute session. Same-name files are rejected, never overwritten. Partial files are removed after a failed transfer when the provider permits. Closing this window or moving the app to the background stops receiving. Uses local HTTP. Folder scans follow your library scan rules.
Incomplete files could not be removed. Grant access to the original receiving folder and start again to retry cleanup.
